target: appearance in general recommendation responses only
folds: Reuse 5 existing fixed seeds times 5 restaurant folds from the prior pilot
imputation: Unique training restaurants only; numeric median and price-unit mode; no test-label use

glmm.prediction: Integrate unseen restaurant and response intercepts

tuning: None. All variants are reported, no favorable seed or feature subset is selected for the main conclusion.
sensitivity: Fixed folds restricted to complete profiles, then also omit MD-R01 and MW-R04 identity/branch concerns
scope: Exploratory associations in purpose-selected original 30; not prospective causal or population inference
